name: Hyperbridge HandlerV1 MMR verifier accepts out-of-range leaves
summary: HandlerV1.handlePostRequests copies caller-supplied leaf indices into its inlined MerkleMountainRange verifier, which never rejects leaves outside every peak. A proof with leafCount 1 and a forged leaf at index 1 reconstructs the genuine root from the proof node alone, so the unverified request is dispatched to the host. Forged TokenGateway requests released escrowed WETH, MANTA and CERE and reassigned the bridged-DOT admin, whose unlimited mints were dumped into DOT pools; forged HostManager requests withdrew host fee balances on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and BNB Chain.

loss.notes: Floor of exactly measured victim depletion: TokenGateway escrow and host fee balances released by forged requests, plus the counter-assets paid out of pre-existing bridged-DOT pools by swaps before each pool's first liquidity change. Later pool outflows (net 98.05 ETH on Base, 91.12 ETH on Arbitrum over the campaign) mix pre-existing and newly added liquidity and are excluded, as are the dilution of bridged-DOT holders, 14.93 yTRYB, 1527.25 CICADA and 2732.70 faketaxi of unpriced pool outflows, and sub-$20 LINK, VIRTUAL, GMX and EURC outflows. Hyperbridge's revised $2.5m figure includes DOT-denominated losses not measured here. ETH on L2s and native-ETH pools uses the Ethereum WETH price; all prices are taken at the anchor.

ageReset.description: EthereumHost hostParams.handler (slot 15) switched from 0x089248e869aecd66199b64637207d366d6cfe92d to HandlerV1; only the configured handler may call dispatchIncoming.

sources.note: Root cause, anchor and age. Decoding handlePostRequests(address,(((uint256,uint256),bytes32[],uint256),((bytes,bytes,uint64,bytes,bytes,uint64,bytes),uint256,uint256)[])) (selector 0x9d38eb35) from the transaction input, or from the callTracer frame when called internally, for every PostRequestHandled (topic 0xa73d58a0fd0647075f9f6b1d18358fcb27c8f8f164fd05c4f9d3e9d5c4f3b64d) on EthereumHost 0x792a6236af69787c40cf76b69b4c8c7b28c4ca20 from block 22059566 to 24868100 gives 2888 transactions; only source-1 and source-4 carry a leaf with index >= leafCount (index 1, leafCount 1, one proof node, source 'EVM-42161', to TokenGateway 0xfd413e3afe560182c4471f4d143a96d3e259b6de). The same scan of the Arbitrum (host 0xe05afd4eb2ce6d65c40e1048381bd0ef8b4b299e, 3643 transactions), Base (0x6ffe92e4d7a9d589549644544780e6725e84b248, 3754) and BNB Chain (0x24b5d421ec373fca57325dd2f0c074009af021f7, 8949) hosts from each HandlerV1 deployment to 2026-04-14 finds the first forgeries at 0x308591d5e031e56d44cfe89ffcfca312d8217b92e276fd1ea5affd936dd6bc37 (timestamp 1776053649), 0xd526b71a0c5daec0e47fe271952984f6ad658c6023012bcc1bd76dfbe06374c9 (1776053645) and 0x6a9637088539d3a5a9400c56a14de04a73d97c7d3c67a841023459c09de1a130 (1776053633), all after source-1. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 24868029, index 0): creation by 0xc0564bba9ba5a9be95ae866429f936012e1bf143 deploys 0x53bb42f3... and 0xccd363e1..., which calls HandlerV1; HandlerV1 calls the host, the host calls TokenGateway onAccept (0x0fee32ce) and TokenGateway transfers 245.930356583188974044 WETH out; no DELEGATECALL leaves HandlerV1, so the verifier is inlined. Verified HandlerV1 source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode): MerkleMountainRange.CalculateRoot assigns leaves to peaks via leavesForSubtree and pushes the next proof node as a peak when none fall under it, with no check that all leaves were consumed; the post-mortem (source-6) adds that check as the fix. Age: eth_getCode of HandlerV1 is empty at block 22059565 and keccak256 of the runtime is the recorded hash at blocks 22059566 and 24868028, and on Arbitrum, Base and BNB Chain at the same address. Source-2 creates it through CREATE2 deployer 0x4e59b44847b379578588920ca78fbf26c0b4956c. hostParams() handler reads 0x089248e8... through block 22059927 and HandlerV1 from 22059928 (source-3, a governance request relayed through the previous handler, HostParamsUpdated at log 86, handler at data word 26); eth_getStorageAt slot 15 matches, and still holds HandlerV1 at block 24868028. The four later HostParamsUpdated events (blocks 23485544, 23619739, 24318228, 24493093) keep the same handler.

Loss. For every forged transaction (Ethereum 1894 through block 24890000, Arbitrum 1, Base 7, BNB Chain 5), receipt Transfer logs from TokenGateway, the host or HostManager 0xf3ad39ff7cf3902a922b0d43e35388b3c7ea66ed and native value frames from them: Ethereum TokenGateway WETH 245930356583188974044 (source-1), MANTA 211503962062242456382023 and CERE 232740429515226193 base units (10 decimals) (source-4, second actor 0xfde0d157... via 0x80bf7db6...); host DAI 545336502930185702253 in 323 transactions and ETH 23053207912551841 wei in 165; Base TokenGateway WETH 65138783636401742, host USDC 511543717, ETH 13369947562541558; Arbitrum host DAI 384879143143165927082, ETH 5460193630941533; BNB Chain host USDT 897413457517346743633, BNB 22904718979544106. Bridged DOT 0x8d010bf9c26881788b4e6bf5fd1bdc358c8f90b8 was minted in 1622 Ethereum forged transactions by 35 senders, first source-5 (1e27 base units to 0x31a165a9...). Pools holding DOT before the attack are the Uniswap v4 PoolManagers and PancakeSwap v3 pool 0x91058b53d6143e6df6bb310af2d2618cfd54399c (DOT/WBNB); every other contract recipient held dust. Summing Swap amounts (v4, delta to swapper) or pool deltas (v3) for each pre-attack DOT pool from the chain's first forgery up to its first ModifyLiquidity/Mint/Burn: Ethereum ETH pool 0x68d466f1... 108217457118321758279 wei (7 swaps, first source-5 paying 108238615097010593179); Base ETH pools 0x68d466f1... and 0xc763b5f4... 19549926030297680650, USDC pool 0xdc618b4e... 106994698; Arbitrum ETH pool 0x68d466f1... 4960748023237162694, USDC pool 0x2c3cb964... 93037005; BNB Chain BNB pool 0x68d466f1... 5151589355698565062, USDT pools 0x174514b8..., 0xed79e864..., 0xa85734ff... 232246674459891911136 (last swap before block 92239318), PancakeSwap WBNB 392708853150390877827 (before block 92234177).
